meaning:
ἀπο-λείπω
[in LXX for H2308 יָתַר, etc. ;]
1. to leave, leave behind (in π. a term. techn. in wills; see MM, see word): 2Ti.4:13 4:20, Tit.1:5; pass., to be reserved, remain: Heb.4:6, 9 10:26.
2. to desert, abandon: Ju 6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put…
Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.
Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.
I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you,
Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great…
